title: feat(metadata-admin): dataset designer + live preview (ADR-0021)
body:
Adds the objectui Studio surface for the analytics `dataset` semantic layer (ADR-0021):

- **data-objectstack** `queryDataset(dataset, selection)` → POST `/api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` (inline draft or saved name), bearer-token forwarded for tenant/RLS scoping; no silent client-side fallback.
- **DatasetPreview** (preview registry): live cross-object preview — auto-runs the draft, renders a results table + bar chart (plugin-charts), surfaces compile/RLS errors.
- **DatasetDefaultInspector** (default-inspector registry): structured designer for object / include / dimensions / measures with a closed aggregate dropdown.

Tests: data-objectstack queryDataset (4), DatasetPreview (4), DatasetDefaultInspector (6). No regressions in inspectors/previews suites (149).

Pairs with framework PR (analytics dataset endpoint); `.objectui-sha` there pins this commit.
